messages:
mara: Hey folks — I addressed the review comments on PR #482 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/482). PTAL when you have a minute. Summary: fixed eviction race in kv allocator, added deterministic unit + smoke test, updated changelog, reduced noise in logs. I squashed the WIP commits into one commit.

taylor: Thanks — will grab a look. What's the merge window? we have a canary slot at 17:30 PT today.

cheng: Quick Q — does the new smoke test need a special kvcache seed or infra tweak? worried about CI flakiness.

mara: No special seed; test runs deterministic allocator stub. Local repro: ./scripts/run_smoke.sh --quick
Or: pytest tests/smoke/test_kv_allocator.py::test_eviction -q --maxfail=1

sam: CI was flaking earlier — can you rebase onto main to pick up the infra fix? Also please squash into one commit if possible (keeps history tidy).

mara: Rebased and force-pushed (sha: abc1234). I already squashed into one commit and tightened the commit message: "kv allocator: fix eviction race + smoke". Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/482/commits/abc1234

ci-bot: build/status: All checks passed ✅ — unit tests: 312 passed, smoke: 1 passed. Coverage: no change.

deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved: 17:30 PT (us-west1) for PR #482. Tagging rollout pipeline.

taylor: LGTM from me. Left a tiny optional nit about one noisy log line (not blocking). :thumbsup:

cheng: LGTM as well. No blockers from my side.

sam: tiny nit: please add a one-line release note to CHANGELOG under Unreleased.

mara: Added release note entry and pushed (sha: def5678). Will merge after canary starts unless someone asks to hold.

taylor: Approved. Merge when ready.

mara: Merging now. I'll monitor canary for 20m and roll back on anomalies. Thanks everyone :rocket:

deploy-bot: PR #482 merged into main at 2621112225. Canary rollout started and health checks nominal.
